question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Clear as mud
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Clear as mud"** means something that is very difficult to understand. (समझने में बहुत कठिन)

 
 
• **Example: **The instructions he gave were as clear as mud, and nobody knew what to do next.
 
 
 
• **"Clear as mud"** refers to something that is not at all clear or is very confusing. (बहुत उलझन भरा)
 
 
• **Example: **The legal document was clear as mud to the layperson.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A dirty surrounding **(गंदा परिवेश): An area that is not clean.

 
 
• **Example:** The park had become a dirty surrounding due to the litter left by visitors.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Very easy to understand **(समझने में बहुत आसान): Something that is simple to comprehend.
 
 
• **Example: **The math problem was very easy to understand.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A clean surface** (साफ सतह): A surface that is free of dirt or stains.
 
 
• **Example:** The table had a clean surface after it was wiped down.
